# Screenshot studio

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/screenshot-studio/

Style a screenshot with a soft gradient background, padding, rounded corners and an optional browser-style frame. Export a presentation-ready image.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Frame an app screenshot with a sage backdrop before sharing a project update.

## Limits and checks

The window frame is decorative. Padding and rounded corners change the image canvas rather than the underlying app interface.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
